title: Run prompt
text: Trim and lock before asynchronous work.
explanation: Vue refs keep prompt, result, mode and timeline while the lab stays mounted across sections. The synchronous running flag blocks duplicate submissions.

title: POST to same-origin API
text: Send JSON to the relative Nitro endpoint.
explanation: Nuxt serves UI and API together. No private model key or separate backend address belongs in the browser.

title: Invoke Nitro Node handler
text: Route the request to a Node adapter.
explanation: Nitro file routing invokes a real H3 handler. The Node preset supports SDK subprocesses and awaited streaming response pipelines.

title: Validate bounded JSON input
text: Check origin, media type and prompt.
explanation: The adapter bounds actual raw bytes before buffering; the shared handler enforces JSON and a trimmed 1–4000 character string. Forwarded TLS is trusted only with explicit proxy configuration.

title: Start real SDK runtime
text: Call the official query async iterator.
explanation: Each run owns temporary work/home/config directories. Tools, settings, skills, MCP, plugins and persisted sessions are disabled. The production output explicitly packages the platform-native CLI.

title: Exchange messages with Claude
explanation: The CLI-backed SDK owns model HTTPS transport. This excerpt shows the actual application boundary, not invented provider HTTP code.

title: Project safe SDK message
text: Select public text and lifecycle fields.
explanation: Thinking, session IDs, private paths and tool payloads are not exposed. Exact configured-key occurrences are redacted. These are SDK messages rather than token deltas.

title: Flush and pipe SSE bytes
text: Flush headers and await the response pipeline.
explanation: Node pipeline handles backpressure. Response close aborts owned execution; request-body completion alone does not cancel inference. Heartbeats and application deadlines have separate purposes.

title: Update Vue timeline
explanation: The 500-row visible history cap does not stop final-result processing. Assistant text can appear before the final result.
code:
if (messages.value.length < 500) messages.value.push({ ...message, elapsed: (performance.now() - started) / 1000 });
if (message.type === 'ResultMessage' && isAgentResult(message.data)) result.value = message.data;

title: Normalize final SDK result
text: Preserve answer, turns, duration, cost and error.
explanation: Unreported cost remains null. A non-success SDK subtype remains an error even if the raw flag is false.

title: Validate final result event
text: Require a typed result and completion event.
explanation: Malformed or truncated streams fail safely rather than displaying unfinished execution as success.

title: Render safe colored Markdown
explanation: Highlight.js colors fenced code, including Vue/XML and TypeScript. DOMPurify removes active markup before v-html. Unknown languages remain escaped text.

title: Complete result plus done
text: Send done after a completed SDK iterator.
explanation: The service requires a final SDK result. Transport completion does not override its error state.

title: Send safe stream failure
text: Emit a generic failure without done.
explanation: Raw provider diagnostics stay private. The 180-second application deadline aborts owned SDK work and clears stream timers.

title: Show recoverable error
text: Show safe feedback and release controls.
explanation: Cancel aborts fetch. Finally clears the elapsed timer. Lesson navigation remains available for recovery.

title: Reject missing server key
explanation: Nuxt dev loads .env; the local production launcher explicitly loads it. Hosted Node reads injected server variables. Missing key returns query 503 or stream error without done.
